name: Crushing Blow
benefit:
You can make a Stunning Fist attempt as a full-round action. If successful, instead of stunning your target, you reduce the target’s AC by an amount equal to your Wisdom modifier for 1 minute. This penalty does not stack with other penalties applied due to Crushing Blow.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 116
When using this feat, you can spend either 2 or 4 stamina points. If you do, the Crushing Blow attack reduces the target’s AC by an additional 1 for every 2 stamina points you spent.
flavor: Your focus allows you to smash your enemy’s defenses.
